rules.name: ZERO-PRIOR-MEANING
rules.description: Start semantic discovery from `UNKNOWN`. A remembered, dictionary, exegetical, conventional, doctrinal, or model-internal meaning MUST NOT be used as the starting definition of a Quranic root or lexeme.
rules.impact: Prevents confirmation bias and circular reconstruction.
rules.trigger: Any root/lexeme semantic analysis.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: The analyst starts with a known gloss and bends occurrences to fit it.

rules.name: PRIOR-CONTAMINATION DISCLOSURE
rules.description: A model cannot guarantee that it has forgotten a previously known meaning. If a candidate hypothesis matches a known prior, label it `PRIOR_CONTAMINATED` and require independent Quran-internal support.
rules.impact: Makes hidden model knowledge auditable instead of pretending it was erased.
rules.trigger: A hypothesis resembles a remembered gloss, prior project result, dictionary meaning, or earlier conversation result.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Claiming an inference was independently discovered when it may have been recalled.

rules.name: CORPUS-FIRST GATE
rules.description: No root-core claim may be proposed before the required root corpus has been assembled.
rules.impact: Prevents a famous verse or domain from defining the root for all other occurrences.
rules.trigger: Before `CANDIDATE_HYPOTHESIS`.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Defining a root from one verse and then using the rest as confirmation.

rules.name: LOW-FREQUENCY FULL COVERAGE RULE
rules.arabic_label: قاعدة التغطية الكاملة للجذور قليلة الورود
rules.description: When the root has a small manageable corpus, 100% of confirmed occurrences MUST be examined before a root-core conclusion.
rules.impact: Eliminates avoidable sampling bias where complete inspection is feasible.
rules.trigger: Small/limited root corpus.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Omitting an inconvenient occurrence.

rules.name: HIGH-FREQUENCY ROOT COVERAGE RULE
rules.description: For a large corpus, inspect at least 10 occurrences selected for maximal contextual, morphological, syntactic, and domain diversity. This is a minimum, not automatic sufficiency.
rules.impact: Gives a disciplined starting point without pretending a small sample is full coverage.
rules.trigger: A root whose full corpus is impractical in the current task.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Ten near-duplicate examples are treated as representative.

rules.name: ADVERSARIAL SAMPLING RULE
rules.description: Sampling MUST seek occurrences most likely to break the hypothesis, not occurrences easiest to explain.
rules.impact: Converts sampling from confirmation to falsification.
rules.trigger: Any partial-corpus root analysis.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Convenient sampling of supportive verses.

rules.name: ROOT CORPUS UNITY RULE
rules.description: All explicit derivatives assigned to one root form one mandatory corpus by default, but the corpus MUST be stratified by form/pattern. Shared root/form assignment removes an easy separation excuse; it does not by itself prove the semantic bridge. Separation requires a compelling morphological/root-assignment argument, while unification requires independent bridge evidence.
rules.impact: Prevents both hiding resistant derivatives and forcing a bridge from spelling alone.
rules.trigger: Root-family construction or proposed homonymy/separation.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Either excluding a hard branch because its form differs, or treating formal overlap as proof of one semantic bridge.

rules.name: SINGLE ROOT CORE
rules.description: A confirmed single root has one invariant axial/basic/original Root Concept shared by its explicit derivatives. Forms, constructions, and contexts add layers or select realizations; they do not replace the core. The core MUST NOT be an unprincipled disjunction `A OR B` between unrelated features. Distant branches require a testable bridge; failure to establish it remains `UNKNOWN/C0`, not permission for semantic mutation.
rules.impact: Establishes semantic identity while preventing forced, unfalsifiable unification.
rules.trigger: Any semantic-core proposal or cross-branch bridge.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Unrelated local meanings, or a disjunctive abstraction that fits every branch and predicts nothing.

rules.name: FORM–MEANING COVARIANCE
rules.description: Every linguistically meaningful change in form MUST be investigated for a corresponding semantic contribution. The contribution may be qualitative rather than simply “more meaning”. Form changes include pattern, additions, deletion, gemination, order, pronouns, number, gender, tense/aspect, voice, transitivity, and construction.
rules.impact: Prevents collapsing distinct forms into one local gloss and missing the language’s own distinctions.
rules.trigger: Any comparison of different forms/constructions.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Two materially different forms are translated identically with no account of the structural difference.

rules.name: INDEPENDENT OCCURRENCE ANALYSIS
rules.description: Profile each occurrence independently before allowing another occurrence’s proposed meaning to control it.
rules.impact: Prevents cross-contamination between contexts.
rules.trigger: Local occurrence profiling.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Reading a verse through an interpretation imported from another verse.

rules.name: OBSERVATION ≠ INTERPRETATION
rules.description: Keep claim layers explicit: `OBSERVATION`, `CONSTRAINT`, `HYPOTHESIS`, `INFERENCE`, `EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE`, `RESULT/CONCLUSION`, `UNKNOWN`. Do not silently promote one layer to another.
rules.impact: Makes the inference chain inspectable and blocks intuitive leaps.
rules.trigger: Every material semantic claim.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: “The object is bones” becomes “therefore the verb means raise/assemble”.

rules.name: UNKNOWN IS VALID
rules.description: `UNKNOWN` is a correct outcome when evidence cannot distinguish candidates. Never fill uncertainty with a familiar gloss.
rules.impact: Protects against forced certainty.
rules.trigger: Insufficient evidence or unresolved alternatives.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Inventing a meaning because the system feels obliged to answer.

rules.name: CONCEPT BEFORE GLOSS
rules.description: Build the conceptual structure before choosing a one-word gloss. A root core may be a relational or multidimensional semantic bundle.
rules.impact: Prevents premature synonym substitution.
rules.trigger: Root-core formulation.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: “Find one Arabic word that means this root” becomes the primary task.

rules.name: SEMANTIC BUNDLE BEFORE SINGLE GLOSS
rules.description: When no single word preserves the invariant, retain a compact bundle of linked semantic features before compressing it into a gloss.
rules.impact: Preserves discriminatory structure.
rules.trigger: A single gloss loses important dimensions.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: One broad word erases contact/intensity/interaction distinctions.

rules.name: MINIMAL SUFFICIENT INVARIANT
rules.description: The core should be the smallest invariant structure that explains all confirmed derivatives without importing form-specific or context-specific detail.
rules.impact: Balances overbreadth against overfitting.
rules.trigger: Refining a provisional core.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Core is either so broad that it explains almost any verb, or so narrow that it contains marital/physical specifics.

rules.name: FALSIFICATION GATE
rules.description: A hypothesis is not accepted because many occurrences fit. Intentionally attack it with the hardest occurrence and a stated failure condition.
rules.impact: Controls confirmation bias.
rules.trigger: Before `PROVISIONALLY_ACCEPTABLE`.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Counting only supporting verses.

rules.name: CONTRADICTION ≠ INDETERMINATE
rules.description: Classify occurrence tests as `SUPPORTS`, `COMPATIBLE`, `INDETERMINATE`, or `CONTRADICTS`. Lack of proof is not contradiction. A genuine Root Concept contradiction is more serious than multiple indeterminate cases.
rules.impact: Prevents both over-rejection and hand-waving.
rules.trigger: Occurrence-by-occurrence hypothesis testing.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Treating uncertainty as disproof or calling a contradiction “unclear” to save the model.

rules.name: ROOT
rules.description: Diagnose every apparent mismatch by layer: `ROOT CONCEPT → MORPHOLOGICAL FORM → SYNTAX/CONSTRUCTION → CONTEXTUAL REALIZATION → UTTERANCE MEANING`.
rules.impact: Prevents rejecting the core for an error in form or construction analysis, and prevents using form/context to redefine the core.
rules.trigger: Any resistance or semantic mismatch.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A form-specific effect is mistaken for a new root meaning.

rules.name: MORPHOLOGY MODIFIES THE EVENT, NOT THE ROOT CORE
rules.description: Morphology changes event structure, participant roles, intensity, aspect, causation, reciprocity, or related layers while preserving the invariant root core.
rules.impact: Enforces both R08 and R09.
rules.trigger: Cross-form comparison.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Assigning unrelated core meanings to derived patterns.

rules.name: DERIVATIONAL LAYERING
rules.description: Preferred order when evidence permits: `ATTESTED ROOT FAMILY / LEAST-MARKED EVIDENCE → ROOT CORE CANDIDATE → FORM OPERATOR CANDIDATE → PARTICLE/CONSTRUCTION → ARGUMENT SEMANTICS → CONTEXT → LOCAL MEANING`. Do not define a marked form first and project its gloss backward into the root.
rules.impact: Makes local meaning traceable and prevents marked-form contamination of the core.
rules.trigger: Any full interpretation or derived-form analysis.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A local or marked-form paraphrase is treated as the root definition.

rules.name: CONTEXT SELECTS, IT DOES NOT REDEFINE
rules.description: Context selects a face/realization of the invariant Root Concept and contributes local detail; it does not replace the core with an unrelated meaning.
rules.impact: Prevents domain-specific dictionaries from fracturing the root.
rules.trigger: Contextual interpretation.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: “In marriage the root means rebellion; in bones it means raise” with no invariant bridge.

rules.name: UTTERANCE MEANING COMPOSITION
rules.description: The speaker’s local meaning is composed from Root Concept + morphology + syntax/construction + particles/relations + context.
rules.impact: Prevents equating root core with sentence meaning.
rules.trigger: Producing a verse-level interpretation.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Translating the root core directly as the whole clause.

rules.name: ROOT-TRACEABILITY GATE
rules.description: Every proposed local meaning MUST be traceable backward through context, syntax, and morphology to the invariant Root Concept without an unexplained semantic jump.
rules.impact: Detects semantic mutation.
rules.trigger: Before accepting any `LOCAL_MEANING`.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A local gloss cannot show how it derives from the root core.

rules.name: NO-SEMANTIC-MUTATION RULE
rules.description: Form and context may specify, intensify, weaken, distribute, temporalize, causalize, or relationally realize the core, but MUST NOT mutate it into a concept of a different semantic kind.
rules.impact: Protects root identity.
rules.trigger: Any context-specific paraphrase.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Unexplained jumps between unrelated semantic domains.

rules.name: REVERSE-STRIPPING TEST
rules.description: Strip local layers in reverse: remove context-specific detail, construction, morphology, and affixes; compare the remaining invariant across derivatives.
rules.impact: Aids discovery of the shared root core.
rules.trigger: Refining a candidate core.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: The proposed common remainder disappears when local layers are removed.

rules.name: CROSS-DERIVATION INVARIANCE TEST
rules.description: Test whether the same core remains recognizable across noun/verb/verbal noun, transitive/intransitive, physical/abstract, and other derivational contrasts.
rules.impact: Direct test of R08.
rules.trigger: Before high confidence.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A core only works in one derivational form.

rules.name: LEXICAL DISTINCTIVENESS
rules.description: Consistency across occurrences is necessary but not sufficient. The extracted Root Concept must be lexically distinctive and MUST NOT collapse into a complete identity with another Quranic lexeme. Different Quranic forms are presumed to carry meaningful distinctions unless strong evidence shows only contextual functional convergence.
rules.impact: Adds `Lexical Identity` to `Meaning Consistency`.
rules.trigger: After a provisional core survives the corpus.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: The definition could be copied unchanged as the full definition of another Quranic word.

rules.name: NO PERFECT SYNONYMY AS DEFAULT
rules.description: Do not assume perfect Quranic synonymy. Large overlap is possible, and two words can be functionally equivalent in one local context, but full lexical identity requires exceptional evidence.
rules.impact: Prevents flattening Quranic lexical choice.
rules.trigger: Comparing near-synonyms.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: “X and Y mean exactly the same everywhere” without proof.

rules.name: NEAREST-LEXEME DIFFERENTIATION
rules.description: After a root core becomes provisionally acceptable, compare it with the nearest Quranic lexemes and state the smallest qualitative difference that explains the lexical choice.
rules.impact: Prevents premature finalization of a broad core.
rules.trigger: Before `HIGH_CONFIDENCE`.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: No attempt to distinguish the core from its closest Quranic neighbors.

rules.name: SEMANTIC-RESIDUE TEST
rules.description: Subtract the semantic territory already covered by the nearest competing lexeme; the remaining discriminating feature is a candidate component of lexical identity.
rules.impact: Helps isolate what is uniquely carried by the target root.
rules.trigger: Overlap with a near lexeme.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Shared meaning is mistaken for the unique core.

rules.name: COUNTERFACTUAL-SUBSTITUTION TEST
rules.description: Mentally substitute the closest Quranic alternative into the construction and ask what semantic or functional property is lost or changed.
rules.impact: Tests whether the proposed lexical distinction has explanatory value.
rules.trigger: Lexical differentiation.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Substitution changes nothing because the proposed core is too broad.

rules.name: LEXICAL COLLISION GATE
rules.description: Before `HIGH_CONFIDENCE`, verify that the Root Concept does not fully collide with the concept of another Quranic lexeme. If it does, refine the core or keep the result unresolved.
rules.impact: Final lexical-identity safety gate.
rules.trigger: Final root-core approval.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A “final” core is semantically indistinguishable from another lexical item.

rules.name: REFERENCE-FRAME NEUTRALITY
rules.description: Do not preselect the semantic axis (up/down, near/far, motion/rest, union/separation, etc.). Infer the relevant relation from the corpus.
rules.impact: Prevents searching on the wrong conceptual dimension.
rules.trigger: Early hypothesis generation.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Selecting “vertical height” because one nearby word is “raise”.

rules.name: RELATIONAL-SEMANTICS CHECK
rules.description: When occurrences repeatedly involve multiple participants/parts, test whether the root describes a relation among them rather than movement or state of one isolated element.
rules.impact: Reveals relational cores hidden by verb-centered paraphrase.
rules.trigger: Multi-participant corpus.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Treating a relational event as simple movement.

rules.name: PHYSICAL–RELATIONAL INVARIANT
rules.description: If the root occurs in physical and emotional/social domains, preserve one abstract invariant that can realize in both; do not create separate unrelated dictionary meanings.
rules.impact: Tests cross-domain unity.
rules.trigger: Domain shift in the corpus.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Creating unrelated domain-specific dictionary meanings instead of testing one invariant.

rules.name: STATE-TRANSITION MODELING
rules.description: Model each occurrence as `STATE BEFORE → TARGET EVENT/STATE → STATE AFTER`, where the text supports such a transition.
rules.impact: Extracts constraints without prematurely naming the meaning.
rules.trigger: Sequential, physical, spatial, or process-like contexts.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Jumping from event to gloss without describing the state change.

rules.name: CONTRAST-AXIS SEARCH
rules.description: When two items are structurally contrasted, search for the shared semantic axis on which they differ rather than interpreting each in isolation.
rules.impact: Can reveal the root’s operative dimension.
rules.trigger: Parallel contrast, alternatives, opposite instructions, or paired states.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: BACKFILL_REQUIRED

rules.name: STRUCTURAL NON-REDUNDANCY
rules.description: When `X` and `Y` occupy the same grammatical alternative slot (e.g., `X أو Y`), an analysis that makes them nearly redundant requires strong evidence.
rules.impact: Uses lexical choice as a constraint.
rules.trigger: Coordination/alternative structures.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Collapsing two explicitly contrasted lexemes into near-total synonymy.

rules.name: CONTRASTIVE-NEIGHBOR GATE
rules.description: Do not define target `X` using a prior meaning of neighboring `Y`. If the distinction is decisive, analyze `Y` independently under the same method before using it as a comparator.
rules.impact: Prevents importing dictionary meaning through a neighboring word.
rules.trigger: X/Y contrast drives the argument.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Defining one contrasted lexeme solely from a prior meaning assigned to its neighbor.

rules.name: ADJACENCY ≠ SYNONYMY
rules.description: A nearby word, rhetorical echo, or later result does not define the target root.
rules.impact: Blocks associative glossing.
rules.trigger: A tempting nearby lexical cue.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Treating a nearby rhetorical echo or result as a synonymic definition.

rules.name: RESULT ≠ ROOT CONCEPT
rules.description: A physical or contextual result of performing the action is not necessarily the root core.
rules.impact: Distinguishes consequence from lexical invariant.
rules.trigger: A visible outcome tempts direct glossing.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Treating a visible consequence of an action as the invariant root concept.

rules.name: EXPLANATORY SPECIFICITY GATE
rules.description: A candidate must distinguish the root from generic concepts and nearest Quranic neighbors. It MUST generate at least one negative prediction and preserve a lexical semantic residue beyond participant frame or near-neighbor overlap.
rules.impact: Prevents vacuous fits and post-hoc abstractions.
rules.trigger: A candidate fits everything too easily or uses generic words such as relation/change/action/state.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A core explains every occurrence but excludes nothing and collapses into another lexeme.

rules.name: SEQUENTIAL-STAGE CONSTRAINT
rules.description: In `A ثم B` or another explicit stage sequence, treat A and B as distinct ordered stages and use that distinction to constrain meaning.
rules.impact: Prevents collapsing a stage into the overall process outcome.
rules.trigger: Explicit temporal/process sequencing.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Equating an earlier target event with a distinct later stage in an explicit sequence.

rules.name: REMEDY/RESOLUTION ≠ DEFINITION
rules.arabic_label: العلاج أو الحل لا يعرّف الحالة
rules.description: A remedy, response, or condition that ends a state does not automatically define the state or prove lexical antonymy.
rules.impact: Blocks circular definition from consequences.
rules.trigger: A verse provides actions after naming a condition.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Treating a resolving condition as the lexical definition of the preceding state.

rules.name: REMEDIAL COHERENCE TEST
rules.description: Although a remedy does not define the condition, functional coherence between proposed condition and response may strengthen or weaken hypotheses.
rules.impact: Adds secondary discriminating evidence.
rules.trigger: Competing root/local-meaning hypotheses predict different response logic.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Ignoring that a proposed meaning makes the response sequence unnecessarily incoherent.

rules.name: ROOT POLARITY SEPARATION
rules.description: Do not copy moral, positive, or negative polarity from one context into the invariant root core unless the full corpus requires it.
rules.impact: Keeps neutral lexical structure separate from contextual evaluation.
rules.trigger: A root appears in morally loaded and neutral contexts.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Importing local moral polarity into the invariant root core.

rules.name: NO DOMAIN DOMINANCE
rules.description: The socially, legally, or traditionally famous domain of a word MUST NOT dominate root-core extraction.
rules.impact: Prevents specialized usage from swallowing the family.
rules.trigger: One domain is much more familiar than others.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Allowing the most famous domain to dominate before cross-domain occurrences are analyzed.

rules.name: ROOT_ASSIGNMENT_UNCERTAIN
rules.description: If assigning a form to a root is morphologically disputed, mark it `ROOT_ASSIGNMENT_UNCERTAIN` and do not let it support or contradict the core until the assignment is resolved sufficiently.
rules.impact: Prevents false contradictions caused by incorrect family membership.
rules.trigger: Competing plausible root analyses.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A disputed form is treated as decisive corpus evidence.

rules.name: HAFS–MADINAH CANONICAL TEXT AUTHORITY
rules.description: Quranic semantic analysis in this Skill uses **Hafs `an Asim only, with the Madinah Mushaf as the canonical reading/text profile**. Other qira'at are outside the semantic evidence scope of this profile.
rules.impact: Fixes the textual/reading basis and prevents cross-reading contamination.
rules.trigger: Canonicalization and quotation verification.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Introducing another reading as semantic evidence in this profile.

rules.name: NO TAFSIR DEPENDENCY
rules.description: Tafsir is excluded from semantic discovery, hypothesis generation, ranking, falsification, lock eligibility, confidence, and registry adoption. It MUST NOT be used as evidence for the Root Core or local lexical meaning. After a valid lock and only on explicit owner request, tafsir may be examined in a separate non-governing historical/interpretive appendix under `POST-LOCK INTERPRETIVE REVIEW POLICY`.
rules.impact: Protects Quran-internal induction while allowing a clearly isolated critical review after the semantic result is frozen.
rules.trigger: Any attempt to retrieve or cite tafsir in or around a semantic analysis.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Using exegetical authority to establish, confirm, correct, enrich, or reject a lexical meaning.

rules.name: QURAN-INTERNAL SEMANTIC SOVEREIGNTY ENFORCEMENT
rules.description: Quranic semantic meaning is discovered and tested from the Quran-internal corpus only. Tafsir, dictionaries, hadith, poetry, inherited usage/terminology, translations, glosses, synonym lists, WordNet/WSD labels, and model-remembered meanings MUST NOT serve as semantic evidence, confirmation, enrichment, correction, tie-breaker, or hypothesis source at any stage. A separate owner-requested historical/comparative or interpretive review is outside the semantic pipeline, begins only after lock, follows the dedicated policy, and cannot revise or validate the internal result.
rules.impact: Prevents inherited meaning from contaminating discovery or post-lock validation.
rules.trigger: Any attempt to introduce external/inherited semantic material.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: External authority supplies or confirms the target meaning.

rules.name: PHONIC/ORDER INTUITION HYPOTHESIS
rules.description: The articulatory/acoustic qualities of letters and their order may offer a natural intuitive clue to the Root Concept and may support the view that Arabic wording can disclose aspects of meaning through its own form. This is a hypothesis-generation/enrichment channel, not governing proof.
rules.impact: Opens a disciplined path for sound-symbolic intuition without allowing retrofitted storytelling.
rules.trigger: After or alongside internal hypothesis generation, never as sole proof.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Inventing a sound story after the desired meaning is already chosen.

rules.name: GEMINATION/SHADDA INTENSIFICATION HYPOTHESIS
rules.description: Gemination/shadda is a form change and may correlate with pressure, force, intensification, compression, recurrence, or another strengthened realization of the root concept. The exact contribution must be learned from usage and MUST NOT be assumed universally.
rules.impact: Connects sound/form change to R09 while keeping the specific effect empirical.
rules.trigger: Geminated vs non-geminated forms.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: “Every shadda always means more force” asserted without corpus testing.

rules.name: CORPUS COVERAGE
rules.description: `Corpus Coverage = examined confirmed occurrences / total confirmed occurrences in the declared root corpus`. This is a factual percentage and MUST NOT be inflated because the sample is diverse.
rules.impact: Separates actual coverage from confidence.
rules.trigger: Every root analysis.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: BACKFILL_REQUIRED

rules.name: CONTEXT DIVERSITY COVERAGE
rules.description: Report how well the examined set covers distinct contextual, morphological, syntactic, participant, and domain patterns found in the corpus. Keep this separate from raw occurrence coverage.
rules.impact: Explains why a small sample can still be structurally informative without pretending it is complete.
rules.trigger: Partial corpus or multi-domain root.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A 10% sample is called “70% coverage” because it was diverse.

rules.name: SEMANTIC ROBUSTNESS
rules.description: Semantic Robustness is an ordinal assessment of how strongly the proposed core survives the examined evidence, alternatives, and falsification. It is reported separately from Corpus Coverage and Context Diversity, but may be influenced by them. It is not a probability.
rules.impact: Separates quality of hypothesis from quantity of inspected material.
rules.trigger: Reporting a provisional or strong Root Core candidate.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Converting sample count into a probability-like confidence number or calling reported metrics causally independent.

rules.name: HYPOTHESIS LIFECYCLE
rules.description: Use explicit states: `UNKNOWN → CANDIDATE_HYPOTHESIS → QURAN_TESTED → PROVISIONALLY_ACCEPTABLE → ENRICHED → HIGH_CONFIDENCE`, with `CONTRADICTED → REVISE/REJECT`.
rules.impact: Prevents a hypothesis from being presented as a result too early.
rules.trigger: Any semantic hypothesis.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Candidate wording is reported as settled meaning.

rules.name: FORMAL-RULE REGISTRY
rules.description: Every formal Rule/Gate MUST preserve at least: Name; Description; Weight; Impact; Trigger; Failure Mode; and canonical Status. Provenance, Related Rules, Examples, Regression Test, and Generalization Scope are required before promotion to `REGRESSION_BACKED`; legacy entries lacking them are marked `BACKFILL_REQUIRED` in the machine-readable registry rather than silently treated as complete.
rules.impact: Makes methodology evolution auditable and prevents rules from disappearing into prose or being promoted without scope.
rules.trigger: Adding, refining, or promoting methodology.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A local lesson becomes an unscoped universal rule or is lost in discussion.

rules.name: NEGATIVE DETERMINATION
rules.description: A root analysis may conclusively reject a candidate core before the correct positive core is fully identified. Negative determination is an independent scientific result.
rules.impact: Allows reliable progress without forcing premature positive closure.
rules.trigger: A candidate claims to be the invariant core and a decisive confirmed occurrence makes that claim impossible or illicitly forced.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: “We cannot reject X until we know the exact correct meaning.”

rules.name: SEMANTIC EXCLUSION LEDGER
rules.description: Maintain rejected candidates with candidate, status, decisive evidence, logical rule, confidence, reopen condition, and mandatory `rejection_scope`, such as `REJECTED_AS_ROOT_CORE`, `REJECTED_AS_FORM_CONTRIBUTION`, `REJECTED_IN_CONSTRUCTION_X`, or `REJECTED_AS_LOCAL_MEANING`.
rules.impact: Prevents rejected meanings from silently re-entering and prevents root-level rejection from erasing a valid local realization.
rules.trigger: Any candidate is falsified or excluded.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A rejected Root Core is reintroduced, or a root-level rejection is misread as prohibition of every local gloss.

rules.name: ROOT CORE ≠ LOCAL REALIZATION
rules.description: The invariant Root Core is distinct from a context-specific realization produced after morphology, construction, particles, participant roles, and context are applied.
rules.impact: Prevents local paraphrases from becoming root definitions.
rules.trigger: Any apparently familiar local meaning such as obligation, writing, rebellion, contract, or withdrawal.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: `كتب عليكم` → “therefore كتب = obligation.”

rules.name: REALIZATION DIVERSITY WITHOUT CORE MUTATION
rules.description: A single invariant core may have widely different physical, relational, legal, or abstract realizations. Diversity of realization does not license multiple unrelated root meanings.
rules.impact: Preserves R08 while allowing compositional richness.
rules.trigger: Same root appears across distant domains.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Assigning one root meaning per domain because local paraphrases differ.

rules.name: DECISIVE CONTEXT PRINCIPLE
rules.description: Contexts are weighted by information gain. A context may receive `DECISIVE` status only after material structural alternatives are recorded and it passes R101/R102 robustness requirements.
rules.impact: Prevents frequency or a preferred parse from masquerading as decisive evidence.
rules.trigger: Ranking occurrences or labeling one decisive/governing.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A famous or structurally sensitive verse is called decisive without robustness.

rules.name: INFORMATION-GAIN WEIGHTING
rules.description: Weight evidence by how much it reduces viable hypotheses, not merely by occurrence count.
rules.impact: Improves sample design and hypothesis ranking.
rules.trigger: Choosing contexts for a high-frequency root or comparing evidence strength.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Frequency voting.

rules.name: CAN-MEAN
rules.arabic_label: حدود ما يمكن وما لا يمكن أن يعنيه
rules.description: Report semantic boundaries as `REQUIRED`, `PERMITTED`, `EXCLUDED`, and `UNKNOWN` features, not only a single gloss.
rules.impact: Captures reliable negative knowledge and preserves uncertainty.
rules.trigger: Any provisional Root Core.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Forcing one polished sentence to hide boundary uncertainty.

rules.name: DECISIVE NEGATIVE EVIDENCE
rules.description: One confirmed decisive occurrence can reject a universal Root Core candidate even if it does not identify the correct alternative.
rules.impact: Operationalizes falsification for universal lexical claims.
rules.trigger: A candidate claims invariance across the root corpus.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Saving a candidate by labeling the decisive counterexample “special” without a general rule.

rules.name: ASYMMETRIC SEMANTIC CERTAINTY
rules.description: Confidence in rejecting a candidate may legitimately be much higher than confidence in the current positive core. Report them separately.
rules.impact: Prevents false symmetry between identification and exclusion.
rules.trigger: Strong falsification but incomplete positive differentiation.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Lowering a decisive rejection merely because the positive core is still provisional.

rules.name: CORE-TO-REALIZATION DERIVATION CHAIN
rules.description: Every local meaning must expose: `ROOT CORE + FORM OPERATOR + PARTICLE/CONSTRUCTION + ARGUMENT SEMANTICS/ROLE + CONTEXTUAL FACE = LOCAL MEANING`. Any unresolved layer remains `UNKNOWN`.
rules.impact: Prevents form, particle, argument, or context contributions from being deposited into the Root Core.
rules.trigger: Any local gloss or verse interpretation.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A local meaning is asserted with no traceable layer attribution.

rules.name: MORPHOLOGICAL OPERATOR INVARIANCE
rules.description: A recurring morphological form/pattern is investigated under a one-invariant-contribution hypothesis across roots. This methodological principle does not establish any concrete operator value. Every concrete value carries an evidence scope label.
rules.impact: Extends stability testing to morphology without turning a local gloss into a Quran-wide law.
rules.trigger: Interpreting a derived pattern or comparing the same form across roots.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: The form is assigned unrelated ad-hoc meanings, or one root-local value is universalized.

rules.name: MORPHOLOGICAL CONTRIBUTION ≠ ROOT CONTRIBUTION
rules.arabic_label: مساهمة الصيغة لا تساوي مساهمة الجذر
rules.description: Explicitly separate root contribution from form contribution and label the operator claim scope: `LOCAL_CONSTRUCTION | ROOT_INTERNAL | CROSS_ROOT_SUPPORTED | CORPUS_WIDE_SUPPORTED | REGRESSION_BACKED`.
rules.impact: Prevents form semantics from contaminating the Root Core and prevents scope inflation.
rules.trigger: Derived forms, voice, transitivity, gemination, number, tense/aspect, etc.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A form-specific effect is stored as root meaning or described at broader scope than evidence supports.

rules.name: CROSS-ROOT FORM TEST
rules.description: Infer a form contribution by comparing the same form across deliberately diverse roots, subtracting root-specific cores, testing competing operator hypotheses, and recording claim scope.
rules.impact: Provides an empirical Quran-internal method for morphology.
rules.trigger: Form semantics are uncertain or proposed beyond one root.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Defining a pattern from one root or from inherited school glosses.

rules.name: BAYAN/STABILITY ASSUMPTION
rules.description: Expect non-arbitrary semantic stability in roots, forms, particles, and recurring constructions, while treating each concrete operator value as an empirical hypothesis. Stability does not override corpus contradiction.
rules.impact: Encourages system discovery while preserving falsifiability.
rules.trigger: The same operator receives unrelated explanations across contexts/roots.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Either arbitrary operator polysemy or forced invariance despite contradiction.

rules.name: SUMMARY MUST INCLUDE EXCLUSIONS
rules.description: A mature root-analysis summary must state the current core candidate, what the root cannot mean as a shared core, decisive evidence for each exclusion, the rule/gate used, and unresolved questions.
rules.impact: Makes negative knowledge visible and reusable.
rules.trigger: Final/provisional root report.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Reporting only the favored definition.

rules.name: SELF-REFERENTIAL DECISIVE CONTEXT
rules.description: When actor and target/related participant collapse to the same referent, hypotheses that require two independent parties are sharply constrained or rejected.
rules.impact: High information gain for participant-role semantics.
rules.trigger: A construction in which normally separate semantic roles collapse into one referent.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Inventing an external obligor/obligee to save a two-party definition.

rules.name: ROLE-COLLAPSE TEST
rules.description: Re-test every candidate when semantic roles collapse into one referent; the candidate must still work naturally without fabricated participants.
rules.impact: Detects hidden role assumptions.
rules.trigger: Reflexive/self-referential constructions.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Candidate works only after splitting one referent into artificial roles.

rules.name: ABSTRACT-OBJECT DECISIVE TEST
rules.description: A confirmed abstract-object use is decisive against making a physical instrument or physical manifestation the invariant Root Core.
rules.impact: Separates underlying relation from one material realization.
rules.trigger: Root applies to abstract content/state without required material medium.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Pen, ink, surface, or physical inscription is made necessary for the root.

rules.name: CONSTRUCTIONAL INVARIANT ACROSS PARTICIPANTS
rules.description: When the same root+construction recurs with different participants, extract the stable constructional contribution across participant changes.
rules.impact: Separates lexical, constructional, and participant semantics.
rules.trigger: Repeated structures such as `كتب + على` with self vs others.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Participant-specific interpretation is assigned to the construction itself.

rules.name: DEONTIC REALIZATION ≠ ROOT CORE
rules.description: Obligation/requirement in some `كتب + على` contexts is a possible deontic local realization, not automatically the invariant Root Core.
rules.impact: Blocks legal-domain dominance.
rules.trigger: Legislative occurrences.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: “كتب means impose/oblige” based only on legislation.

rules.name: ANALYTICAL MOVE → FORMAL RULE
rules.arabic_label: من الحركة التحليلية إلى قاعدة رسمية
rules.description: Any analytical move that materially improves accuracy or prevents a recurring failure must be generalized into a named Rule/Gate rather than left as discussion prose.
rules.impact: Converts discoveries into reusable methodology.
rules.trigger: A correction, decisive inference, or repeated successful diagnostic.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Same mistake recurs because the lesson was never formalized.

rules.name: PRINCIPLE BEFORE EXAMPLE
rules.description: Extract the general principle that makes an example informative, then preserve the example as illustration/regression.
rules.impact: Prevents the Skill from becoming a bag of memorized examples.
rules.trigger: A particularly strong verse/example teaches a reusable lesson.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Example is stored without transferable logic.

rules.name: RULE PROVENANCE
rules.description: Every formal Rule/Gate should record or preserve its origin case, failure prevented, related rules, example(s), regression test, and status where practical.
rules.impact: Makes rule evolution auditable.
rules.trigger: Adding/updating a rule.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Rules accumulate without knowing why they exist.

rules.name: RULE IMPACT WEIGHTING
rules.description: Rules are weighted by the effect of violation: `CONSTITUTIONAL/CRITICAL`, `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `SUPPORTING/HYPOTHESIS`. Higher-impact rules take precedence in constrained analysis.
rules.impact: Prevents minor heuristics from competing with validity controls.
rules.trigger: Rule registration or conflict.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A supporting intuition overrides corpus/falsification controls.

rules.name: FAILURE-MODE-DRIVEN RULE DESIGN
rules.description: Each rule should identify the concrete failure pattern it prevents, not only describe ideal behavior.
rules.impact: Makes rules testable.
rules.trigger: Creating/revising a rule.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Vague guidance with no detectable violation.

rules.name: GENERALIZE WITHOUT OVERGENERALIZING
rules.description: Generalize only as far as evidence supports. Every root-local operator/rule claim MUST state `generalization_scope` and promotion evidence. New rules may begin `PROPOSED/PROVISIONAL` and advance after independent regression success.
rules.impact: Prevents one case from becoming a false universal law.
rules.trigger: Promotion of a local observation, Rule/Gate, particle value, or form value.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: One example becomes a claim about all Quranic Arabic.

rules.name: RULE REGRESSION REQUIREMENT
rules.description: Important rules should have one or more regression cases, including a must-pass and preferably a must-fail path.
rules.impact: Prevents later Skill revisions from losing methodology.
rules.trigger: Rule reaches `AGREED` or higher.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Rule exists only in prose and is never tested.

rules.name: DISCOVERY LOG → RULE REGISTRY
rules.arabic_label: من سجل الاكتشاف إلى سجل القواعد
rules.description: Distinguish provisional discoveries from owner-agreed formal rules. Suggested lifecycle: `OBSERVED → PROPOSED_RULE → AGREED → REGRESSION_BACKED → weighted formal status`.
rules.impact: Prevents temporary ideas from silently becoming constitution.
rules.trigger: Methodology discussion.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Hypothesis and rule status are conflated.

rules.name: RULE CONSISTENCY CHECK
rules.description: Every new rule must be checked against existing constitutional controls before admission; conflicts require explicit revision rather than silent coexistence.
rules.impact: Keeps the methodology coherent.
rules.trigger: Adding/updating a rule.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A new rule permits what ZERO-PRIOR-MEANING or SINGLE ROOT CORE forbids.

rules.name: METHOD VALUE > LOCAL ANSWER
rules.arabic_label: قيمة المنهج أعلى من الجواب المحلي
rules.description: The project values reusable methodological improvement above merely solving one lexical item. Successful or failed analyses must be mined for transferable rules before moving on.
rules.impact: Compounds quality across future roots.
rules.trigger: Completion/correction of an analysis.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Good local answer but no retained lesson.

rules.name: SAME-VERSE LEXICAL COLLISION GATE
rules.arabic_label: بوابة التصادم اللفظي في الآية نفسها
rules.description: Independent co-occurrence of the target and a proposed perfect synonym strongly supports non-identity. It does **not** by itself identify the positive semantic residue; positive differentiation requires independent corpus evidence or a separate discriminating test.
rules.impact: Prevents both synonym collapse and unsupported residue invention.
rules.trigger: Candidate synonym co-occurs independently with target.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Either `كتب = جمع`, or “therefore the difference must be X” without evidence.

rules.name: NECESSARY COMPONENT ≠ DEFINING CORE
rules.description: A property may be necessary to a root model without being sufficient to define its lexical identity.
rules.impact: Prevents reducing a specific root to a broad component.
rules.trigger: Candidate such as collect, bind, move, or fix explains part of the pattern.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: “K-T-B involves collection, therefore K-T-B = collect.”

rules.name: NORMATIVE BINDING ≠ STRUCTURAL BINDING
rules.arabic_label: الربط المعياري لا يساوي الربط البنيوي
rules.description: Distinguish legal/deontic obligation from the more general structural binding/constraint of elements in a system. Normative obligation may be a local realization rather than the invariant core.
rules.impact: Prevents legislative contexts from overfitting the root.
rules.trigger: Root appears in both legal and non-legal contexts.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Every binding relation is paraphrased as legal obligation.

rules.name: FALSE-CONTENT NEUTRALITY TEST
rules.description: If the root applies to false, corrupt, or illegitimate content, truth, authority, legitimacy, or correctness cannot be invariant Root Core requirements.
rules.impact: Separates structural act/state from epistemic or moral status.
rules.trigger: Confirmed false-content occurrence.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: “What is written is inherently authoritative/true.”

rules.name: DOWNSTREAM EVENT ≠ ROOT CORE
rules.description: A later purpose/result/event in the same clause or verse must not be equated with the target Root Core merely because it follows from it.
rules.impact: Prevents result-to-definition collapse.
rules.trigger: Purpose/result clauses such as `لـ`, `ثم`, consequence statements.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: `كتب ... ليجمعنكم` → “therefore كتب = جمع.”

rules.name: INSTRUMENTAL REALIZATION ≠ ROOT CORE
rules.description: A physical instrument or material realization used in some occurrences must not be promoted to Root Core when the root is confirmed in non-instrumental/abstract contexts.
rules.impact: Prevents pen/hand/surface from defining K-T-B.
rules.trigger: Root has both material and abstract uses.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Physical writing is treated as the root itself.

rules.name: SEMANTIC DEFINITION REGISTRY
rules.description: Preserve formally tracked definitions in a versioned registry with status, boundaries, decisive/structurally sensitive contexts, rejected alternatives and scope, local realizations, coverage/confidence, provenance, reopen condition, and regressions. Governance separation is mandatory: `LOCK_INTERNAL_RESULT ≠ OWNER_ACCEPTANCE ≠ REGISTRY_ADOPTION`.
rules.impact: Preserves decisions without prior leakage or unauthorized promotion.
rules.trigger: A locked result is prepared for owner review or a stored definition is revised.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Chat-only definitions, pre-lock leakage, or automatic promotion from lock to AGREED.

rules.name: BLIND SOURCE ISOLATION GATE
rules.description: A run MUST NOT be described as blind unless source isolation is verifiable through a pinned manifest of allowed and blocked sources. Prompt-level instructions to “ignore priors” are insufficient if semantic priors remain accessible.
rules.impact: Makes blindness an auditable source property rather than a behavioral claim.
rules.trigger: Start of any blind root/lexeme rediscovery run.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A result is described as independently discovered even though registry definitions, prior analyses, translations, or other semantic priors were accessible.

rules.name: FROZEN METHODOLOGY DURING BLIND RUN
rules.description: The methodology and Skill versions are pinned at blind-run start. Newly observed failure modes or rule ideas are logged as discovery events but MUST NOT alter the active run procedure.
rules.impact: Prevents the experiment from changing its own success criteria while being evaluated.
rules.trigger: A potential new Rule/Gate is discovered pre-lock.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: The analyst changes methodology mid-run and then treats the result as tested under one stable method.

rules.name: FORM-IDENTITY VERIFICATION GATE
rules.description: Before an occurrence is used as evidence for a morphological claim, verify its exact formal identity: root length and assignment, additions, gemination, stem form, voice, aspect/view, mood, pronouns, relevant inflection, and high-impact construction features. Absence of a derived-form tag in a structural resource does not by itself prove triliteral Form I.
rules.impact: Prevents false semantic generalization from morphological misclassification and prevents structural buckets from being mistaken for linguistic operators.
rules.trigger: Any bare/derived-form comparison, operator claim, or aggregation of untagged/base records.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A derived form is treated as the base form, or an untagged bucket is labeled Form I although it contains quadriliteral or otherwise unverified members.

rules.name: CLAIMED-COVERAGE EVIDENCE GATE
rules.description: A numerical corpus-coverage claim requires an auditable Evidence Matrix representing every occurrence counted in the numerator and denominator and its verification state.
rules.impact: Separates real coverage from a query count or narrative claim.
rules.trigger: Any `Corpus Coverage = X%`, `all occurrences`, or equivalent statement.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A tool count or sample is reported as complete coverage without occurrence-level evidence.

rules.name: POSITIVE-HYPOTHESIS COMPETITION GATE
rules.description: Strong negative determination does not authorize immediate promotion of the first surviving abstraction. Generate genuinely competing positive hypotheses plus `C0`, each with predictions and falsification conditions.
rules.impact: Prevents premature abstraction after conventional glosses are rejected.
rules.trigger: A strong exclusion ledger with no positively discriminated core.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: Several familiar glosses are rejected and one newly invented abstraction is accepted simply because it is the only positive candidate formulated.

rules.name: STRUCTURAL-AMBIGUITY BEFORE DECISIVENESS
rules.description: An occurrence MUST NOT be labeled decisive when its inferential force depends on an unverified parse, attachment, pronoun antecedent, ellipsis, scope, or other structurally material choice.
rules.impact: Prevents a false Root Core built on one preferred parse.
rules.trigger: Any high-information occurrence with a structurally consequential alternative.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: `UNVERIFIED PARSE → FALSE DECISIVE CONTEXT → FALSE ROOT CORE`.

rules.name: DECISIVE-CONTEXT ROBUSTNESS ACROSS PARSES
rules.arabic_label: متانة السياق الحاسم عبر التحليلات النحوية
rules.description: After plausible structural analyses are enumerated, test the decisive claim across them. If a reasonable parse removes the decisive force, downgrade the occurrence to `STRUCTURALLY_SENSITIVE_CANDIDATE`.
rules.impact: Makes decisiveness depend on structural robustness.
rules.trigger: More than one materially plausible parse for a high-information occurrence.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A context remains “decisive” although a reasonable alternate parse makes it merely indeterminate.

rules.name: ARGUMENT-STRUCTURE ≠ ROOT CORE
rules.arabic_label: بنية المشاركين لا تساوي المفهوم الجذري
rules.description: A participant frame such as “entity + location/state” or “source + target” is not sufficient to identify a Root Core. The analysis must isolate the lexical property that distinguishes this relation from roots sharing the same frame.
rules.impact: Prevents syntax/argument structure from masquerading as lexical identity.
rules.trigger: Root proposals phrased mainly as participant relations.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: `PARTICIPANT FRAME → MISTAKEN FOR LEXICAL IDENTITY`.

rules.name: CONSTRUCTIONAL-CONTRIBUTION SUBTRACTION
rules.description: Before a semantic feature is assigned to the Root Core, subtract all contribution plausibly attributable to morphological form, particles, construction, argument semantics/roles, and context.
rules.impact: Prevents constructional meaning from being deposited into the root.
rules.trigger: Derived forms, particle constructions, semantically rich objects/arguments, and alternating valency/constructions.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A feature originating in `ب/ل/من`, a form operator, argument meaning, or construction is asserted as root meaning.

rules.name: ABSTRACT-CORE OPERATIONALIZATION GATE
rules.description: An abstract Root Core is not accepted merely because it is broad enough to fit the corpus. Its abstract terms must be converted into testable REQUIRED/EXCLUDED features, predictions, competitors, and a falsification condition.
rules.impact: Prevents unfalsifiable rhetorical abstractions.
rules.trigger: Core wording such as relation, structure, determination, realization, independence, transition, or other high-level abstractions.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: `OVER-ABSTRACT CORE → UNIVERSAL COMPATIBILITY → ZERO DISTINCTIVENESS`.

rules.name: ROOT-CORE PREDICTIVE CONTENT GATE
rules.description: A mature Root Core must constrain an occurrence or feature not used to build it. It must generate a prediction capable of failing rather than merely explaining observations post hoc.
rules.impact: Gives operational content to falsification.
rules.trigger: Transition from `QURAN_TESTED` toward lock eligibility.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A post-hoc model that accepts every possible outcome.

rules.name: CROSS-DERIVATION BRIDGE EVIDENCE GATE
rules.description: When derivational branches appear semantically distant, SINGLE ROOT CORE does not license an invented abstraction. A testable semantic bridge must show how the invariant survives across the branches without semantic mutation.
rules.impact: Prevents forced unification.
rules.trigger: Materially distant nominal/verbal, physical/abstract, bodily/relational, or other derivational branches.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: `SINGLE ROOT CORE PRESSURE → OVERGENERALIZED BRIDGE`.

rules.name: LOCK ELIGIBILITY GATE
rules.description: `LOCK_INTERNAL_RESULT` requires an explicit Lock Eligibility Report. Analyst conviction is insufficient.
rules.impact: Makes lock auditable and separates a strong candidate from a lock-qualified result.
rules.trigger: Request to transition from Semantic Boundary to lock.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: A persuasive core is locked despite unaudited coverage, unresolved structural ambiguity, missing C0, weak differentiation, or hidden contradictions.

rules.name: UNATTESTED-BASE FORM CAUTION GATE
rules.arabic_label: بوابة الحذر من الصيغة الأساس غير الموثقة
rules.description: عندما تكون صيغة مشتقة موثقة في corpus بينما الصيغة الأساس المقارنة غير موثقة أو غير مستقرة، يُمنع اختراع gloss للأساس واستخدامه دليلًا على مساهمة الصيغة المشتقة. تُستخرج النواة من الأسرة الموثقة، ويُخفض نطاق دعوى العامل الصرفي.
rules.impact: يمنع صناعة معنى أساس افتراضي ثم استخدامه Prior خفيًا في تفسير المزيد.
rules.trigger: صيغة مزيدة موثقة مع غياب الأساس أو ضعف دليله.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: `UNATTESTED BASE → INVENTED GLOSS → FALSE FORM OPERATOR`.

rules.name: PRIVATIVE-CORE POSITIVE-RESIDUE GATE
rules.description: إذا صيغ مرشح Root Core بوصفه مجرد غياب أو نفي لخاصية X، يجب البحث خصوميًا عن سياق يذكر غياب X بصورة مستقلة مع بقاء اللفظ المستهدف غير زائد. إذا بقي له أثر دلالي، فالنواة السلبية المحضة غير كافية، ويجب استخراج البقية الإيجابية بعد طرح مساهمة الصيغة والتركيب.
rules.impact: يمنع التعريفات السلبية الواسعة التي تقبل كل المواضع لأنها لا تقدم محتوى تمييزيًا موجبًا.
rules.trigger: تعريف من نوع «غياب X / لا Y / من دون Z».
rules.failure_mode_prevented: `PRIVATIVE CORE → UNIVERSAL FIT → NO POSITIVE PREDICTION`.

rules.name: OPERATOR-CONTRIBUTION INDEPENDENCE & INVARIANCE
rules.description: كل عامل لغوي متكرر—صيغة صرفية أو حرف أو تركيب—يُبحث تحت فرضية مساهمة جوهرية مستقرة يمكن فصلها عن Root Core وعن معنى المشاركين والسياق. لا يثبت أي معنى محدد للعامل إلا بدليل داخلي عابر للبيئات، ويجب وسم نطاق الدعوى.
rules.impact: يوسع R69–R72 من الصيغ الصرفية إلى الحروف والتراكيب، مع منع كل من التفسير الاعتباطي والتعميم المبكر.
rules.trigger: تفسير صيغة أو حرف أو تركيب متكرر، أو اختلاف تفسير العامل نفسه بين جذور/بيئات.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: `LOCAL OPERATOR GLOSS → SILENT GLOBAL LAW`, أو `SAME OPERATOR → UNRELATED AD-HOC MEANINGS`.

rules.name: STRUCTURAL ATTESTATION ≠ OPERATOR SEMANTIC VALIDATION
rules.arabic_label: الإثبات البنيوي لا يساوي إثبات دلالة العامل
rules.description: عدد ورود صيغة، وعدد الجذور المرشحة، ووسم QAC أو أي مورد بنيوي يثبت وجود البنية أو ترشيح هويتها فقط؛ ولا يثبت المساهمة الدلالية للعامل. يجب فصل `structural_status` عن `semantic_status` وعن `claim_scope` وعن حالة `Evidence Matrix`.
rules.impact: يمنع تحويل كثرة الشواهد البنيوية إلى قانون دلالي، ويحفظ الفصل بين طبقة البنية وطبقة الاستنباط.
rules.trigger: الاستدلال بعدد الصيغ أو الجذور أو وسم مورد صرفي على معنى الوزن أو الحرف أو التركيب.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: `STRUCTURAL COUNT → SEMANTIC CERTAINTY` أو `QAC TAG → OPERATOR MEANING`.

rules.name: MORPHOLOGICAL OPERATOR STACK NON-COLLAPSE
rules.description: المعنى الموضعي للصيغة المركبة يجب أن يفصل طبقاتها المستقلة: `ROOT CORE + STEM FORM + ASPECT/VIEW + VOICE + MOOD + NOMINALIZATION/PARTICIPLE + PARTICLE/CONSTRUCTION + ARGUMENTS + CONTEXT`. لا يجوز دمج أثرين أو أكثر في gloss واحد ثم نسبتهما إلى الجذر أو إلى وزن اشتقاقي واحد.
rules.impact: يمنع نسبة أثر المبني للمجهول أو التام/غير التام أو المزاج أو المصدر/اسم الفاعل إلى Root Core أو Stem Form، ويجعل تغاير المبنى قابلًا للتتبع.
rules.trigger: كل لفظ يحمل أكثر من سمة صرفية/نحوية مؤثرة، أو كل مقارنة بين صيغ تتغير فيها عدة طبقات معًا.
rules.failure_mode_prevented: `MULTIPLE OPERATORS → SINGLE UNTRACEABLE GLOSS` أو `VOICE/ASPECT EFFECT → ROOT OR FORM MEANING`.
